title: TV Remote Long-Press Timer, Live TV Category Focus & Channel Surfing Touch Controls
releaseNotes:
• Long-Press Timer for Remote Controls: Added a reliable 500ms coroutine timer on DPAD Center / Enter KeyDown in TvFocusableCard, ensuring onLongClick triggers properly on Android TV remotes that do not send continuous repeat events
• Live TV Category Navigation & Up-Scroll Containment: Fixed category card Right and Click navigation to route directly to the channels selection row, and strictly locked UP navigation at the top category (favorites) to prevent escaping to the preview screen
• Podcasts Episode-to-Channel Navigation: Enabled fuzzy and substring channel matching when long-pressing podcast episodes, with graceful fallback to matching feed episodes and resetting scroll to the top
• Fullscreen Touch Channel Surfing: Added floating touch Up and Down buttons on fullscreen Live TV for phone and touch users to navigate previous and next channels seamlessly
